## FilesystemError.code property

The underlying OS errno code (e.g. `'ENOENT'`<!-- -->, `'EACCES'`<!-- -->), when the Node host bridge was able to supply one. `undefined` when no code was available — never fabricated.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly code: string | undefined;
```
